claim: Demo data stays separate and is discarded when you start for real
sandbox: fresh browser context; seed real data; /demo; generate a distinct sample record; start for real; assert real data is untouched, demo database and counter are deleted, and a new demo contains only its seed

claim: One click opens a prepared sample invoice
where: README opening and landing primary action
sandbox: fresh 390 px browser context; open /; click Try it with sample data once; assert /?demo=1, the demo banner, sample filename, populated billing client, and sample record

claim: Keeps the original invoice intact
sandbox: fresh browser context; /demo; generate and parse the downloaded PDF

claim: Exports the relationship log as CSV
sandbox: fresh browser context; /demo; download and inspect the sample CSV

claim: CSV cells beginning with =, +, -, or @ cannot run spreadsheet formulas
sandbox: fresh browser context; ordinary workspace; generate a record whose exported fields begin with =, +, -, and @; download the CSV; assert every dangerous cell is prefixed as literal text

claim: Downloads the relationship log as a complete JSON backup
where: Relationship log action, privacy notice, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; /demo; download and parse the JSON; assert the supported version, export date, and every sample record field

claim: Imports a valid Performed For JSON backup
where: Relationship log action, privacy notice, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; ordinary workspace; import a complete version 1 backup; reload; assert the imported relationship remains visible

claim: Deletes one relationship record without clearing the others
where: Relationship log action, privacy notice, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; import two records; confirm deletion of one; reload; assert only the selected record was removed

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh isolated 390 px browser context against a fresh production build and Vite preview; await service-worker activation and controller acquisition; set the context offline; reload to a 200 response; generate and parse the sample PDF without a network

claim: Text stays at least 16 px, and visible controls stay at least 44 × 44 px on phones
sandbox: fresh browser context; check every route at 390 px and at a 320 px 200%-zoom-equivalent reflow width; measure all visible text and interactive controls; assert no horizontal overflow

claim: Privacy, Terms, and the not-found page open directly
sandbox: fresh browser context; directly load /privacy, /terms, and an unknown path; assert route-specific titles, one h1, the main landmark, and the designed not-found state

claim: Automated checks find no serious or critical accessibility issues on Privacy, Terms, and the not-found page
sandbox: fresh browser context; directly load /privacy, /terms, and an unknown path at 390 px; run Axe and assert no serious or critical findings

claim: Runs on your device
sandbox: fresh browser context; /demo; generate sample package; record every request origin

claim: No analytics
sandbox: fresh browser context; /demo; generate sample package; assert every request is same-origin GET

claim: No cloud document storage
sandbox: fresh browser context; /demo; generate sample package; assert every request is same-origin GET

claim: The selected invoice PDF is cleared from the tab after a successful download
where: Invoice file help, privacy section, privacy notice, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; ordinary workspace; select a named PDF; generate and await the download; assert the input and selection UI are empty, then assert another generation requires choosing the PDF again

claim: A $19 one-time purchase unlocks unlimited packages
sandbox: fresh browser context at the free limit; returned-license fixture; generate another package and assert the public production checkout URL

claim: A $19 one-time purchase includes saved client suggestions on this device
sandbox: fresh browser context; fixture-verified license; generate a relationship; reload; assert both client datalists retain the values and use them for another generated package

claim: An active license can be restored on another device
sandbox: two fresh browser contexts; paste the same fixture-valid token in the second context, verify it, and generate past the free limit

claim: Reset demo restores the original sample
sandbox: fresh browser context; /demo; change fields and generate a row; reset; assert the original filename, fields, single seed row, and unlimited demo counter

claim: Unreadable saved records can be removed without clearing valid records or the saved license
sandbox: fresh browser context; seed one valid and one malformed IndexedDB record plus a valid cached license; remove malformed entries and reload

claim: Checkout and license verification use the Sociobot billing API
sandbox: fresh browser context; fixture-verify a pasted token, inspect the checkout URL and captured request origin, and inspect built JavaScript for no payment-provider endpoint

claim: Buying opens the hosted Dodo checkout, whose merchant-of-record service handles order inquiries and returns
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert the purchase link discloses its external hosted destination; request the public product checkout without purchasing; assert its 303 Dodo location and the hosted page's merchant-of-record wording

claim: The cover says the end client is not liable for payment
sandbox: fresh browser context; /demo; assert the workspace helper and captured cover-canvas text say the billing client is the payer and the end client is not liable

claim: No third-party scripts or CDN fonts are used
sandbox: fresh browser context; load and generate in /demo while recording script, stylesheet, font, and image requests; assert each request is same-origin

claim: Accepts invoice PDFs up to 25 MB
sandbox: fresh browser context; generate with an exact 25 MiB valid PDF, then assert a 25 MiB plus one byte PDF is rejected

claim: Three packages are free
sandbox: fresh browser context; ordinary workspace; generate three downloads and assert the fourth attempt is blocked at the boundary

claim: Project / PO reference is preserved exactly as entered
sandbox: fresh browser context; input the permitted maximum relationship values; capture every canvas text draw

claim: The download adds an end-client cover before the original invoice pages
where: Landing headline and output summary, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; /demo; generate from a known two-page invoice; inspect cover drawing calls, page order, and original page content streams

claim: A refunded or revoked purchase deactivates its license
sandbox: fresh browser context; seed a previously valid but stale verdict at the free limit; return a revoked fixture verdict; assert the inactive notice and blocked generation

claim: Generating a package adds its exact relationship to the local log
sandbox: fresh browser context; /demo; generate a distinct relationship; reload; assert the client names, reference, filename, and creation date remain in the demo database

claim: Clearing this site's browser data removes local records and the license token
sandbox: fresh browser context; seed an ordinary record, generation count, license token, and verdict; clear all origin storage through Chromium; reload and assert each is absent
